featured_reviews.name: Vanji
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are considering this institute for JEE preparation, look beyond the advertisements and headline ranks.

At the time of admission, most of us asked the wrong question. We focused on top percentiles and a few success stories, which may not be relevant. Aakash contribution and quality will be visible in below....

The real questions should be:

How many students appeared in total?
How many scored below the 90 percentile?

That gives you the real picture.

The quality of education does not match the expectations set during enrollment.

Teachers are changed frequently, reportedly due to salary-related issues. This lack of stability directly impacts continuity in teaching and seriously affects students preparation.
There is no consistent academic mentoring or structured guidance. Strong follow-up is visible until all installments are paid. After that, the engagement and accountability noticeably decline.

If I had to make the decision again, this institute would be at the bottom of my list. Pls learn from other mistakes, instead of you repeating one....

featured_reviews.name: avion dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. Class Scheduling: Classes are being scheduled at irregular times throughout the week, including Sundays. This lack of consistency is making it difficult for students to plan their academic and personal commitments effectively.

2. Incomplete Syllabus Coverage: A significant portion of the syllabus remains unfinished, which is causing anxiety among students as exams approach. Timely and structured completion of the curriculum is essential for adequate preparation.

3. Lack of Personal Attention: Students who are struggling in specific subjects or topics are not receiving the individual guidance they need. Personalized support was one of the key commitments made during admission, and we request that this be addressed.

4. Saturday Class Conflict: Classes scheduled on Saturdays often with extended college hours, leaving students exhausted and unable to focus. This is counterproductive and needs reconsideration.

5. Unfulfilled Promises: Several commitments made at the time of admission — including structured timelines, doubt-clearing sessions, and mentorship — have not been upheld. This has led to disappointment and a sense of disconnect between expectations and reality.

We sincerely hope these issues can be addressed promptly to ensure a more effective and supportive learning environment. We value the efforts of the faculty and management, and we believe that with better coordination and attention, the coaching experience can be significantly improved.

Thank you for your understanding.
